description: This file sets up and runs a conversational pipeline using various components like speech activity detection, language model, and transport handlers. It contains asynchronous functions for bot operation, event handlers for client connection events, and configuration for external services and parameters.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the context for the language model, holding conversation history.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Handles the aggregation of LLM context for user and assistant roles.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the processing pipeline combining multiple processing steps.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline and its configuration for execution.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for pipeline execution.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages running and controlling the pipeline lifecycle.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class for different transport implementations.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters specific to the Daily transport.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and executes the main processing pipeline with event handlers for client connection and disconnection.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point for starting the bot which initializes transport and runs the pipeline.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Imports and invokes the primary script entry point.
